<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex01062025-05-1313-03-48" status="reviewed"><note type="gloss"/>
               'dir <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">kha cig</rs> ni re | las dang po bas sems bskyed pa mi bya' ste | mi skye ba'i phyir dang | <choice><corr>skyes</corr><sic>kyes</sic></choice> kyang nyams par
               <lb n="21a4"/> 'gyur bas | slar nyes pa che pa'i phyir ro || zhes zer ba ni mi 'thad de | snying rje can byang chub sems dpa'i rigs can yang yod la | dge' bshes la brten pa 'am | thos bsam lasogs pas bsam pa khyad par can du gyur pa yod pa la <note type="gloss">mi skye ba'i <sic>tan</sic> tshigs ma grub te</note> ci 'i phyir mi skye | <note type="gloss">nyams °° <choice><corr>gtan</corr><sic>tan</sic></choice> tshigs yang ma grub ste</note> bshes gnyen rten pa lasogs pa rkyen bzang po dang 'brel pas mi nyams par 'gyur ba'i phyir dang | <note type="gloss">°°°°°</note> <lb n="21a5"/> nyams kyang sdeig pa sbyangs zhes yang gsos btab pa'i sgo nas gnyen po goms nas bstan par 'gyur ba'i 'ang phyir dang | byed pa rgyu' mthun skye ba gzhan du 'phen pa'i phyir | sems bskyed pa don yod pa kho na'o ||</seg></TEI>
